displayPattern: 7-segment display on a *R9S96, *D9S96 or *R9S92 single-stage furnace in IOG-2037B (Goodman GR9S96, GD9S96 and GR9S92, and the Amana models in that same guide): EbL
meaning: Blower current too low after the heat on-delay: the main blower is below the value the control expected, and the furnace goes to hard lockout.
causes: Blower motor not operating correctly, or the wrong speed setting
diySteps: Write down EbL before power is removed. Hard lockout does not clear by waiting out a normal retry
Technician: check for loose motor wiring connections
Technician: verify blower motor voltage, amps and the speed setting. If the blower motor is not operating correctly, replace the motor
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. EbL is a blower-motor current fault that ends in hard lockout.
